tests: credential update transmits exact binary longstr and UTF-8 reason while ordinary channel RPC proceeds
credential replies do not emit unblocked or swallow real flow control events
overlapping credential updates reject without disturbing the accepted request
invalid local reason or oversized frame leaves the credential exchange usable
missing credential acknowledgement times out the whole connection and all pending work
server rejection preserves its reply code and terminates the pending credential exchange
connection close and signal cancellation both release a pending credential update
disconnect during credential update rejects it without replay on the recovered connection
successful update changes only the live connection, keeping application-owned reconnect credentials
scope: Independent TCP peer, exact wire bytes, RPC/flow separation, timeout/close/abort and recovery without replay. Real OAuth broker tests are separate.
